frontMatter.welcome:
Dear Colleague,
Welcome to Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd.
Whether you are joining us for the first time or have been part of our journey for years, we are pleased to have you with us.
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt Ltd is engaged in the field of pharmaceutical manufacturing and development, working to support the healthcare industry through quality-driven processes and responsible operations. Our work is guided by a strong commitment to safety, compliance, and continuous improvement.
We believe that our people are central to our success. This Employee Handbook outlines the policies, expectations, and standards that help us maintain a respectful, safe, and productive workplace. It is designed to support you in your day-to-day work and to ensure fairness and consistency across the organization.
We encourage you to read this handbook carefully and refer to it whenever needed. As the organization evolves, policies may be updated from time to time, and the latest version will always be available through the Human Resources Department.
We thank you for your contribution and commitment, and we look forward to building a strong and successful future together.
Warm regards,
frontMatter.about:
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company engaged in the development and production of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Advanced Intermediates, Key Starting Materials (KSMs), and related chemical compounds. We operate with a strong focus on quality, compliance, and continuous improvement to support the global healthcare industry.
Established in 2018 as part of the Tagoor Group, we are built on the principle of backward integration, enabling efficient, reliable, and quality-driven manufacturing processes. Our operations are supported by dedicated teams across Research & Development, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, and Supply Chain functions.
To develop and manufacture high-quality pharmaceutical products through innovative science, robust processes, and responsible operations, while ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and value creation for customers and stakeholders.
To be a trusted global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner recognized for quality, reliability, and continuous improvement in delivering healthcare solutions.
- Quality First: We are committed to maintaining the highest standards in every stage of our operations.
- Integrity: We conduct our business with honesty, transparency, and ethical responsibility.
- Safety & Responsibility: We prioritize the safety of our employees, community, and environment in all activities.
- Compliance: We strictly adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
- Continuous Improvement: We strive to enhance our processes, systems, and skills through innovation and learning.
- Teamwork & Respect: We value collaboration and treat every individual with dignity and respect.

chapters.title: Emergency Preparedness & Response
chapters.text:
The Company maintains a structured Emergency Action Plan covering fire, chemical spills, medical emergencies, power failures, and natural disasters.
Key provisions include:
- Clearly marked evacuation routes, emergency exits, and assembly points
- Certified first-aid personnel available across shifts
- Emergency contact information displayed at all key locations
- Coordination protocols with local hospitals, fire services, and civil authorities
- Mandatory fire and evacuation drills conducted at least twice per year
- Documented review and improvement of drill outcomes
## Workplace Safety Reporting and Response Procedure
All employees are responsible for reporting incidents, near-misses, and unsafe conditions.
The reporting system includes:
- Structured incident reporting logs (physical and digital systems)
- Clear escalation and response procedures
- Formal investigation of all reported cases
- Root cause analysis and corrective action tracking
- Communication of lessons learned across the organization
## Anti-Retaliation Clause:
No employee shall face retaliation, punishment, or discrimination for reporting safety concerns or participating in investigations.
## Employee Health Monitoring Programme
The Company conducts periodic occupational health assessments based on job roles and risk exposure.
- Mandatory health checks for employees exposed to chemicals, noise, or hazardous environments
- Role-based medical surveillance programs
- Early identification and management of work-related health risks
- Medical follow-up and intervention where required
## Ergonomic Risk Management and Musculoskeletal Health
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. recognizes risks associated with repetitive and posture-related tasks.
Preventive measures include:
- Ergonomic workstation assessments for office and lab areas
- Provision of ergonomic furniture and supportive equipment
- Mandatory micro-break practices for repetitive tasks
- Training on posture, lifting techniques, and safe equipment handling
- Use of anti-fatigue measures where required
## Mental Health & Psychological Safety
The Company promotes a psychologically safe and supportive work environment.
## Preventive Measures:
- Regular workload monitoring and realistic performance expectations
- One-on-one managerial check-ins
- Open-door communication with HR and management
- Training for managers on stress and burnout identification
## Support Mechanisms:
- Confidential Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) access
- Access to professional counselling support
- Structured intervention for employees experiencing stress or mental health challenges
- Encouragement of open discussion around wellbeing without stigma
## Safety for Contractors, Visitors & Temporary Workers
All contractors, consultants, temporary staff, and visitors are required to comply with the Company’s health and safety standards.
Requirements include:
- Mandatory safety induction prior to entry or work
- Compliance with site-specific safety rules
- Use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) where applicable
- Inclusion in emergency response procedures
- Equal application of safety standards across all personnel
## Hazardous Substance Safety
Employees handling hazardous chemicals, biological agents, or industrial materials must follow strict safety protocols.
Key requirements include:
- Certified training in safe handling, storage, labeling, and disposal
- Mandatory use of appropriate PPE
- Access to and understanding of Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS)
- Defined emergency response procedures for spills, exposure, or contamination
- Safe storage and segregation of hazardous materials
- Compliance with laboratory and chemical safety standards
## Continuous Improvement
The Company is committed to continuously improving its health and safety performance through:
- Regular internal safety audits and inspections
- Risk assessments and hazard identification
- Employee feedback and participation programs
- Corrective and preventive action tracking
- Ongoing enhancement of safety systems and infrastructure
## Working hours, leave & compensation
## Work Hours and Employee Time Management
Working hours at Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. are defined in individual employment contracts and comply with applicable Indian labour laws.
- The Company operates based on shift systems (day, rotational, or operational shifts depending on business needs).
- Employees are required to adhere to assigned working schedules and maintain punctual attendance.
- The Company uses approved time-tracking systems to record working hours accurately.
- Periodic internal audits are conducted to ensure compliance with legal limits and to identify excessive overtime or irregular working patterns.
## Employee Attendance and Time Tracking
- Employees must record attendance through the designated attendance system.
- Any late arrival, early departure, or absence must be reported to the reporting manager and HR.

chapters.title: Holidays
chapters.text:
The Company observes national and state-declared holidays as per the annual holiday calendar.
- Holiday lists are issued in advance by HR.
- Certain departments may be required to work on holidays due to operational needs, with applicable compensation or compensatory off as per policy.
## Employee Benefits & Work-Life Support
## Our Commitment
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to providing employee benefits and support systems that:
- Promote employee wellbeing and financial security
- Support physical and mental health
- Encourage work-life balance
- Assist employees with caregiving responsibilities
- Foster an inclusive and supportive workplace culture
- Comply with applicable labour and social security laws
## Employee Medical Support and Health Coverage
The Company provides healthcare support for eligible employees and, where applicable, their immediate dependants.
Healthcare support may include:
- Corporate group health insurance through approved insurance providers
- Reimbursement of eligible medical expenses as per Company policy
- On-site first-aid facilities and occupational health support
- Emergency medical assistance for workplace-related incidents
Details regarding eligibility, coverage limits, and claim procedures are communicated separately by the Human Resources department.
## Statutory Benefits
Eligible employees are provided statutory benefits in accordance with applicable Indian laws, including:
- Provident Fund (PF)
- Employee State Insurance (ESI), where applicable
- Gratuity benefits
- Maternity benefits
- Statutory bonus, where applicable
- Other legally mandated employee benefits
All statutory contributions and deductions are administered in compliance with applicable legislation.
## Family-Friendly Workplace Policies and Employee Support
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. recognizes that employees may have caregiving responsibilities beyond the workplace.
The Company supports employees through:
- Maternity leave with job protection in accordance with applicable law
- Paternity leave provisions
- Supported return-to-work arrangements for eligible employees
- Flexible arrangements for employees with caregiving responsibilities
- Consideration of childcare, eldercare, and dependent care responsibilities in leave and flexibility decisions
The Company aims to create a workplace where employees can balance professional responsibilities with family and personal commitments.

chapters.title: Flexible Work Arrangements and Remote Working
chapters.text:
Where operationally feasible and appropriate to the role, flexible working arrangements may be considered.
Available arrangements may include:
- Flexible start and finish timings
- Remote or hybrid working for eligible roles
- Compressed workweek arrangements by mutual agreement
- Part-time or reduced -hour arrangements, where approved
All flexible work arrangements remain subject to business requirements, performance expectations, operational feasibility, and management approval.

chapters.title: Employee Assistance and Well-being Support Programme
chapters.text:
The Company may provide employees access to confidential support services for personal and professional challenges.
Support services may include:
- Psychological and emotional wellbeing support
- Financial or legal guidance services
- Professional counselling assistance
- Stress and mental health support mechanisms
Employee participation and usage of support services remain confidential and are managed in accordance with privacy requirements.
## Employee Wellbeing Initiatives
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. promotes employee wellbeing through initiatives focused on physical, mental, and workplace wellness.
These initiatives may include:
- Health awareness programs
- Wellness and recreation activities
- Occupational health support
- Ergonomic workplace practices
- Safety and wellbeing campaigns
Employees are encouraged to actively participate in wellbeing programs.
## Employee Recognition & Engagement
The Company values employee contributions and promotes a positive workplace culture through:
- Employee recognition and reward programs
- Long-service recognition initiatives
- Team engagement activities
- Open communication and feedback mechanisms
- Collaborative and respectful workplace practices
## Meals, Facilities & Workplace Support
Depending on operational location and business requirements, employees may be provided with:
- Subsidized meals or meal allowances
- Rest and dining facilities
- Safe drinking water and sanitation facilities
- Transportation or travel-related support, where applicable
## Equal Access to Benefits
Employee benefits and support programs are administered fairly and without discrimination.
The Company does not discriminate in access to benefits on the basis of:
- Gender
- Religion
- Caste
- Nationality
- Disability
- Marital status
- Any other legally protected characteristic
Eligibility for specific benefits may depend on employment type, grade, or statutory criteria.
## Learning, Development & Career Growth
## Our Commitment to Employee Growth
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. believes that investing in people is investing in the future of the organization.
The Company is committed to:
- Providing structured and accessible learning opportunities
- Supporting employees in developing technical, professional, and leadership capabilities
- Enabling employees to prepare for expanded responsibilities and career progression
- Promoting a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and improvement
- Creating meaningful career pathways across functions and levels
## Training & Skills Building
The Company provides a range of learning and development opportunities designed to support role effectiveness and career advancement.
Learning interventions may include:
- Formal classroom and instructor-led training programmes
- On-the-job coaching, mentoring, and knowledge transfer
- Online learning modules and professional certification programmes
- External workshops, seminars, and industry conferences
- Cross-functional assignments and project participation
- Compliance, quality, and safety-related training programmes
Training may be delivered internally or through approved external learning providers.
## Induction & Mandatory Training
All employees are required to complete induction and mandatory compliance training programmes.
Mandatory training may include:
- Workplace safety and emergency procedures
- Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)
- Anti-harassment and workplace conduct
- Quality and regulatory compliance
- Data confidentiality and information security
Completion of mandatory training may be required prior to independent operational responsibilities.
## Performance Review Process
All employees participate in a structured performance review process intended to support development, accountability, and continuous improvement.
The review process may include:
- Annual objective-setting aligned with organizational priorities
- End-of-year performance review and formal feedback
- Documented development recommendations and action plans
Performance evaluations are conducted fairly, objectively, and without discrimination. The process is intended to support employee growth and development rather than functioning solely as a performance rating exercise.
## Individual Development Plans (IDPs)
Employees may work jointly with their managers to create Individual Development Plans (IDPs).
IDPs may include:
- Short-term and long-term career goals
- Strengths and development areas
- Learning objectives and action plans
- Training resources and development timelines
- Organizational support requirements
Development plans may be reviewed periodically and updated based on employee aspirations, performance discussions, and business requirements.
## Career Growth & Internal Mobility
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. encourages internal career growth and mobility wherever feasible.
Internal opportunities may include:

chapters.title: Anti-Discrimination
chapters.text:
Discrimination in any form is strictly prohibited.
Employment-related decisions are based solely on:
- Merit
- Qualifications
- Skills
- Performance
- Business requirements
The Company prohibits discrimination based on:
- Gender
- Gender identity
- Sexual orientation
- Age
- Religion
- Caste
- Ethnicity
- Nationality
- Disability
- Marital status
- Any other legally protected characteristic
This principle applies to:
- Recruitment and hiring
- Promotions and transfers
- Compensation and benefits
- Learning and development opportunities
- Task assignments
- Performance evaluations
- Disciplinary actions and termination
Employees who believe they have experienced discrimination may raise concerns through the grievance reporting mechanisms established by the Company.
Retaliation against any employee who raises a concern in good faith is strictly prohibited and may result in disciplinary action.

chapters.title: Prevention of Harassment — Including Sexual Harassment
chapters.text:
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. maintains zero tolerance for harassment, intimidation, bullying, or hostile workplace conduct in any form.
The Company complies with the Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Workplace Act, 2013 (POSH Act) and maintains appropriate mechanisms for prevention, reporting, and resolution of complaints.
## Preventive Measures
The Company may implement:
- A formally constituted Internal Committee (IC) with required representation
- Mandatory POSH awareness training during onboarding and periodic refresher sessions
- Awareness programmes on respectful workplace behaviour
- Open communication forums and awareness discussions
- Periodic review of complaint handling and response systems
## Reporting & Protection
The Company provides:
- Confidential reporting channels for harassment-related concerns
- Fair and timely investigation processes
- Protection against retaliation for complainants, witnesses, or participants in investigations
- Written communication of investigation outcomes, where appropriate
All complaints shall be handled sensitively, confidentially, and in accordance with applicable law and Company procedures.
## Respectful Workplace Behaviour
All employees are expected to:
- Treat others with dignity, courtesy, and professionalism
- Maintain respectful communication and conduct
- Avoid behaviour that may create an intimidating, hostile, or offensive environment
- Respect cultural, personal, and professional differences
Professional conduct is expected during all workplace interactions, including meetings, electronic communication, travel, training programmes, and work-related social events.

chapters.title: Conflict of Interest Management
chapters.text:
Employees are expected to act in the best interests of the Company and avoid situations where personal interests conflict, or appear to conflict, with Company interests.
- Any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest must be disclosed promptly to the reporting manager or Human Resources department.
- Employees shall not use their position for personal gain or for the benefit of family members, friends, vendors, customers, or external parties.
- Outside employment, consultancy, financial interests, or business activities that may interfere with the employee’s duties or objectivity must receive prior written approval from management.
- Employees shall avoid participating in decisions involving vendors, suppliers, contractors, or business partners where a personal relationship or financial interest exists.
## Inclusion of Employees with Disabilities
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to supporting employees with disabilities and enabling equal participation in the workplace.
Support measures may include:
- Reasonable workplace accommodations
- Accessible infrastructure and facilities, where reasonably practicable
- Inclusive hiring and recruitment practices
- Workplace support arrangements based on individual requirements
- Disability awareness and sensitivity programmes for employees and managers
Employees may discuss accommodation needs confidentially with HR or authorized representatives.
## Employee Resource Groups & Affinity Networks
The Company may support the formation of Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) or affinity networks that encourage inclusion, collaboration, and peer support.
Such groups may include networks supporting:
- Working parents and caregivers
- Women employees
- Cultural or community groups
- Employees with shared professional or social interests
Participation in ERGs is voluntary and open to employees in accordance with Company guidelines.

chapters.title: Diversity Training & Awareness
chapters.text:
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. may conduct training and awareness programmes related to:
- Diversity and inclusion
- Prevention of harassment and discrimination
- Unconscious bias awareness
- Inclusive communication and workplace behaviour
- Cultural sensitivity and mutual respect
Training may be conducted during onboarding and periodically as part of the annual learning calendar.
## Promoting Equal Employment Opportunities
The Company aims to actively create equal opportunities for growth and advancement across the organization.
Initiatives may include:
- Mentorship and coaching programmes
- Equal access to learning and development opportunities
- Transparent promotion and recruitment practices
- Cross-functional exposure opportunities
- Development initiatives supporting underrepresented groups
The Company may periodically review diversity and inclusion progress as part of broader organizational improvement efforts.
## Reporting Concerns & Non-Retaliation
Employees are encouraged to report concerns related to:
- Discrimination
- Harassment
- Bullying
- Exclusionary behavior
- Violations of these Guidelines
The Company:
- Provides appropriate reporting mechanisms through HR or designated authorities
- Investigates concerns fairly and confidentially
- Prohibits retaliation against any individual raising a concern in good faith
False or malicious complaints may result in disciplinary action.
## Responsibilities
## Management Responsibilities
- Promote an inclusive and respectful workplace culture
- Address concerns promptly and fairly
- Lead by example through professional conduct and ethical behaviour
## Employee Responsibilities
- Treat others respectfully and professionally
- Comply with these guidelines and related procedures
- Report inappropriate behavior or violations promptly
## Workplace Misconduct & Disciplinary Action
The Company expects all employees to maintain professional conduct, integrity, discipline, and compliance with Company policies and applicable laws.
The following acts may constitute misconduct and may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment:
- Fraud, theft, bribery, corruption, or misappropriation of Company property
- Falsification or unauthorized modification of records, documents, or data
- Violation of safety procedures or deliberate unsafe behavior
- Harassment, discrimination, bullying, violence, or abusive conduct
- Breach of confidentiality or unauthorized disclosure of Company information
- Data integrity violations, GMP violations, or intentional deviation from approved procedures
- Unauthorized absence, repeated attendance irregularities, or insubordination
- Use of alcohol, illegal drugs, or intoxicating substances during working hours or on Company premises
- Misuse of Company systems, assets, or information technology resources
- Any conduct that adversely affects workplace discipline, safety, productivity, or the reputation of the Company
The Company reserves the right to investigate misconduct and take appropriate corrective or disciplinary action in accordance with applicable laws and Company procedures.
## Grievance & Remediation

chapters.title: Grievance Mechanism
chapters.text:
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to maintaining a workplace that promotes fairness, respect, equal opportunity, safe working conditions, and responsible business practices. The Company encourages employees and stakeholders to raise concerns regarding workplace issues, labour practices, human rights, health and safety, environmental impacts, or any matter that may adversely affect them.
The Company provides a formal grievance mechanism to ensure concerns are reviewed, investigated, and resolved in a fair, timely, and confidential manner.
## Scope
The grievance mechanism is available to:
- Employees.
- Contract and temporary workers.
- Apprentices and trainees.
- Suppliers and contractors.
- Service providers.
- Customers.
- Local communities.
- Other stakeholders interacting with the Company.
## Types of Grievances
Grievances may include concerns relating to:
- Wages, benefits, and compensation.
- Working hours and employment conditions.
- Harassment, discrimination, bullying, or unfair treatment.
- Human rights and labour rights concerns.
- Occupational health and safety issues.
- Environmental impacts or community concerns.
- Working conditions and welfare facilities.
- Supplier or contractor-related concerns.
- Violations of Company policies or legal requirements.
## Reporting Channels
## Grievances may be submitted through:
- Reporting to Manager, Supervisor, Department Head or Human Resources Manager.
- Email: hr@tagoorlab.com
- Written Complaint submitted to the Human Resources Department.
- Suggestion / Complaint Box located at the facility.
- Senior Management
Anonymous grievances may be accepted where sufficient information is available for review.
## Grievance Reporting Process
## Step 1 – Submission of Grievance
The grievance may be submitted verbally, in writing, by email, or through designated reporting channels.
## Step 2 – Registration and Acknowledgement
The grievance is recorded and acknowledged by the Company.
## Step 3 – Assessment and Investigation
The concern is reviewed to determine its nature, severity, and potential impacts. Investigations may include interviews, review of records, and collection of relevant information.
## Step 4 – Resolution
Appropriate actions are identified to address the concern.
## Step 5 – Communication and Closure
Where appropriate, the outcome is communicated to the complainant and the grievance is formally closed.
## Remediation Process
Where investigations, audits, inspections, monitoring activities, or grievance reviews confirm that an individual, community, or stakeholder has been adversely impacted, Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to implementing appropriate remediation measures to address the issue and prevent recurrence.
## Step 1 – Impact Assessment and Root Cause Analysis
The Company evaluates:
- The nature and severity of the issue.
- Individuals or stakeholders affected.
- Potential legal, environmental, social, or operational impacts.
- Root causes contributing to the issue.
- Risk of recurrence.
## Step 2 – Development of Remediation Action Plan
A remediation plan is developed which may include:
- Corrective actions.
- Preventive actions.
- Responsible persons.
- Completion timelines.
- Verification requirements.
## Step 3 – Implementation of Remediation Measures
Depending on the issue identified, remediation measures may include:
[table]
| Issue Identified | Example Remediation Action |
| Wage or Benefit Issue | Payment correction and payroll adjustment |
| Excessive Working Hours | Revision of work schedules and workforce planning |
| Harassment or Discrimination | Investigation, disciplinary action, counselling, and awareness training |
| Health and Safety Hazard | Hazard elimination and workplace improvements |
| Child Labour | Immediate removal from work, protection of the child, and support for continued  |
| Forced Labour | Immediate cessation of practice and worker protection measures |
| Environmental Incident | Containment, clean-up, corrective action, and restoration |
| Supplier Non-Compliance | Supplier corrective action plan and follow-up verification |
| Ethical Misconduct or Corruption | Investigation, disciplinary action, and strengthening of controls |
## Step 4 – Verification of Effectiveness
The Company verifies that corrective actions and remediation commitments have been completed and that the issue has been adequately addressed.
## Step 5 – Closure
The remediation case is formally closed after verification of effectiveness and completion of all required actions.

chapters.title: Quality, Regulatory and Information Security
chapters.text:
- Product quality concerns.
- GMP or regulatory compliance violations.
- Data integrity concerns.
- Information security breaches.
- Data privacy violations.
## Reporting Channels
Whistleblower reports may be submitted through:
- Reporting to Manager, Supervisor, Department Head or Human Resources Manager.
- Email: whistleblower@tagoorlab.com
- Written Complaint submitted to the Human Resources Department.
- Written Confidential Complaint marked "Confidential – Whistleblower Report"
- Senior Management
Anonymous reporting may be permitted where legally allowable and sufficient information is provided.
## Whistleblower Investigation Process
Step 1 – Report Submission A concern is reported through an approved reporting channel.
Step 2 – Registration and Assessment The concern is recorded and reviewed to determine its nature and significance.
Step 3 – Investigation An impartial investigation is conducted, which may include interviews, document reviews, site inspections, and evidence collection.
Step 4 – Findings and Corrective Action Investigation findings are documented and appropriate corrective and preventive actions are implemented where necessary.
Step 5 – Closure The case is formally closed following completion of the investigation and required actions.
## Protection of Whistleblowers
The Company strictly prohibits retaliation against any person who reports a concern or participates in an investigation in good faith. All reports shall be handled confidentially to the extent reasonably practicable and in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
## Good-Faith Reporting
Individuals are expected to report concerns honestly and in good faith. No person will be penalized for reporting a genuine concern, even if it is ultimately found to be unsubstantiated. Knowingly making false or malicious allegations may result in disciplinary action.
## Our Commitment
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. recognizes that employee, customer, supplier, research, operational, clinical, and business-sensitive information are valuable organizational assets.
The Company is committed to:
- Protecting confidential and personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, misuse, loss, or theft
- Maintaining secure information systems and data management practices
- Ensuring responsible handling of sensitive business and personal information
- Promoting employee awareness regarding data privacy and cybersecurity responsibilities
- Complying with applicable data protection and information security requirements, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDPA), and other relevant legal obligations
All employees share responsibility for protecting Company data and information assets at every stage of handling and processing.
## Confidential Information
Confidential information includes, but is not limited to:
- Employee records and personal information
- Customer and supplier data
- Financial information
- Research, formulations, laboratory data, and technical records
- Manufacturing processes and operational information
- Contracts, pricing, and business strategies
Employees must protect confidential information and use it only for authorized business purposes.
Unauthorized disclosure, copying, sharing, or misuse of confidential information is strictly prohibited.
## Data Privacy Principles
The Company processes personal data responsibly and only for legitimate business, legal, or operational purposes.
Key privacy principles include:
- Collection of only necessary information
- Use of data for authorized purposes only
- Restricted access based on business need
- Secure storage and controlled retention of records
- Protection against unauthorized disclosure or misuse
Employees handling personal or sensitive information are required to maintain confidentiality at all times.
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. implements reasonable technical and organizational controls to protect information systems and data.
Security measures may include:
- Password protection and secure authentication practices
- Role-based access permissions based on business necessity
- Periodic review of access rights for sensitive systems and records
- Controlled access to systems, laboratories, server rooms, and sensitive records
- Encrypted storage and secure transmission of sensitive information where applicable
- Antivirus, firewall, and cybersecurity protections
- Data backup and recovery mechanisms
- Automatic session lock or timeout controls on shared or unattended devices
- Secure disposal of confidential records and storage media
- Monitoring and logging of authorized system access where applicable
## Acceptable Use of Company Systems
Company systems, devices, internet access, email platforms, and communication tools must be used responsibly and primarily for authorized business purposes.
Employees shall not:
- Access unauthorized systems or data
- Share passwords or access credentials
- Install unauthorized software or applications

chapters.title: Our Environmental Responsibility
chapters.text:
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to:
- Managing environmental impacts responsibly
- Integrating sustainability into operational decision-making
- Preventing pollution and minimizing environmental risks
- Conserving natural resources and reducing waste generation
- Promoting environmental awareness and responsible workplace practices
- Supporting continuous environmental improvement across all operations
## Legal & Regulatory Compliance
The Company complies with applicable environmental legislation, regulatory requirements, permits, and operational standards relevant to its activities.
This includes compliance related to:
- Air emissions
- Wastewater discharge and effluent management
- Hazardous waste handling and disposal
- Chemical storage and environmental safety
- Resource consumption and pollution control
All required environmental records, licenses, approvals, and monitoring documentation shall be maintained as required by law.
## Resource Conservation & Energy Management
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. promotes the responsible use of energy, water, raw materials, and other operational resources. Employees are encouraged to adopt resource-efficient practices and support the Company’s efforts towards environmental sustainability and operational efficiency.
## Energy Conservation
The Company encourages employees to:
- Use energy efficiently across facilities and operations.
- Switch off equipment, lighting, and utilities when not in use.
- Follow energy-saving practices during daily activities.
- Support initiatives aimed at improving energy efficiency and reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.
- Operate laboratory and operational equipment responsibly as per defined procedures.
## Employees may receive awareness and training on:
- Energy conservation practices.
- Efficient use of equipment and utilities.
- Equipment shutdown and energy-saving procedures.
- GHG emission awareness and reduction initiatives relevant to Company operations.
## Water Conservation
Tagoor Laboratories promotes responsible water management by encouraging employees to:
- Avoid unnecessary water consumption and wastage.
- Report leaks or abnormal water usage promptly.
- Follow water-efficient practices during operational activities.
- Support water conservation, reuse, and efficiency improvement initiatives wherever feasible.
## Material Efficiency
The Company encourages employees to:
- Use raw materials, consumables, and packaging materials efficiently.
- Minimize avoidable consumption and material wastage.
- Follow proper storage and handling practices to prevent material loss.
- Support responsible procurement and sustainable operational practices wherever applicable.
## Waste Management and Segregation Practices
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to minimizing waste generation and ensuring responsible waste handling, storage, recycling, and disposal practices. Employees are encouraged to follow established waste management procedures and support initiatives aimed at reducing environmental impacts.
Employees may receive training and awareness on:
- Waste segregation, reduction, and disposal procedures.
- Proper handling and storage of different waste categories.
- Responsible use of materials to minimize waste generation.
Waste categories managed under Company procedures may include:
- General and recyclable waste.
- Hazardous chemical waste.
- Biohazardous or clinical waste, where applicable.
- Electronic waste (e-waste) and obsolete electronic equipment.
Key practices include:
- Segregating waste at the point of generation.
- Ensuring safe storage and proper labeling of hazardous waste.
- Promoting recycling and reuse initiatives wherever feasible.
- Disposing of waste through authorized and compliant waste management channels.
- Reducing paper consumption and avoiding unnecessary material usage.
Hazardous, biomedical, and electronic waste are managed in accordance with applicable legal and environmental requirements.
## Hazardous Substance Management & Pollution Prevention
Tagoor Laboratories Pvt. Ltd. is committed to minimizing pollution risks and ensuring the responsible management of hazardous substances throughout its operations. The Company implements appropriate controls to promote safe handling, storage, use, and disposal practices in line with applicable environmental and safety requirements.
Key measures include:
- Safe procurement, storage, handling, and disposal of hazardous substances.
- Proper treatment and disposal of wastewater and effluents.
- Implementation of spill prevention and chemical containment measures.
- Following safe handling procedures for chemicals and laboratory materials.
- Regular maintenance of pollution control systems and equipment.
Employees involved in handling hazardous materials may receive role-specific safety and environmental training or certifications relevant to their responsibilities.
